overview_description.description:
Hedgehog builds an open, secure, and fully automated network fabric that brings hyperscaler efficiency to any AI datacenter.

Modern AI workloads demand a fundamentally new approach, tuned specifically for absolute performance and reliability. To make operations effortless, we deliver hyperscaler abstractions—like VPCs and declarative provisioning. This empowers cloud-native teams to use familiar tools and move at the speed of software, rather than the CLI.

Crucially, our open architecture guarantees total hardware flexibility, permanently eliminating vendor lock-in. We let teams focus on delivering value instead of tweaking complex configurations. Hedgehog delivers the turnkey network AI needs.

about_short_description.short_description: Hedgehog delivers open networking software allows organizations design, deploy, and operate modern AI data centers

product.name: Hedgehog Open Network Fabric
product.description: An open-source network fabric software appliance designed for distributed cloud environments, powered by SONiC and Kubernetes.

product.name: Hedgehog Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Service
product.description: A multi-tenant virtual private cloud service that provides network isolation and provisioning via Kubernetes APIs for distributed cloud environments.

product.name: Hedgehog Software Subscription and Support
product.description: A subscription service providing software updates, device certification, and technical support for Hedgehog software and certified network devices.

product.name: Hedgehog Design Partner Program
product.description: A program allowing users to evaluate Hedgehog software and participate in its development through access to pre-release software and direct communication with engineering.

product.name: Hedgehog Certified Network Devices
product.description: A set of network switches and edge devices tested and certified to operate with Hedgehog software for use in distributed cloud network topologies.
